tools.description: Analysis views. Snapshot views: meta|summary|processes|instances|rows (filial_id/setor_id/competencia filters). Live dashboard: dashboard_summary_live|dashboard_process_ranking|dashboard_alerts|dashboard_evolution|dashboard_by_family|dashboard_due_dates|dashboard_strategic_indicators|processes_calculated. Process-scoped (processo_id): process_revision_comparison|decomposition_link_validation|decomposition_draft_suggestion|diagram_validation|diagram_bpmn_xml. Revision-scoped (revisao_id): revision_allocation_diagnostic|revision_diagram_merged|revision_decomposition_merged. impact_effort_matrix accepts processo_id|instancia_id|revisao_id (competencia/horizonte_meses optional). Scope requirements: consolidated views need no ids; view=filial requires filial_id and rejects setor_id; view=department (alias: departamento) requires filial_id AND setor_id — get both via read entity=department first. Filters may ride flat args or the params object (Semantic V3). view=meeting_minute_transcript: non-persisting transcript analysis (params.minute_id + params.data). READ-only — never persists.

limit.description: Result row cap for ranked views.

tools.description: Semantic discovery — context is never authorization. section=overview (default): authenticated user + current workspace refs + discovery hint. section=self: personal context + signature profile. section=workspace: current process/instance/revision/area refs (navigation hint — authoritative facts still require read()). section=catalog: full capability catalog (entities, workflows, write schemas, execution policies, agent_directives); optional entity filters one entity contract.

entity.description: Entity filter for section=catalog — projects one entity contract instead of the full catalog.

tools.description: Semantic read — never writes. Process-engineering domain (processes, WBS/decomposition, BPMN, resources) — not product/item materials composition or bill-of-materials. entity + typed action + params object. Domain entities (process, instance, revision, measurement, investment, shared_resource, resource_cost, resource_link, meeting_minute, process_document, decomposition_tree (process WBS/decomposition tree; id=processo_id — hierarchical process mapeamento macro, not a materials/product bill-of-materials), instance_decomposition_scope, revision_decomposition_overlay, process_diagram, instance_diagram_scope, revision_diagram_overlay, process_bpmn_document, impact_effort_matrix, branch, department): action=search|get — search lists records; get fetches ONE record and requires params.id (never search-all when an id is needed). Search accepts only entity-declared fields (department: filial_id only; branch: none; process: filial_id/setor_id/status/familia_processo/q/has_improvement/page/page_size) — unsupported fields are rejected INVALID_FIELD; per-entity contract via get_context entity=<name>. Do not invent params. Specialized entities: process_context (get: processo_id + optional instancia_id/revisao_id — authoritative process intelligence), process_timeline (get: processo_id — needs an already-identified process, not discovery), solution (catalog|context), helpdesk (session|capabilities|tickets|ticket|attachment|catalog), meeting_minute (pending_signatures|audit|versions|participants|signers|generate_from_transcript), directory_user (search: q required ≥2 chars, optional limit≤20, include_self — Core directory for Delpi user_id resolution before meeting_minute participants/signers; ambiguity=true means ask the user, never pick by name alone), evidence (list), task (my_tasks|task|process_tasks; my_tasks params: status, scope=received|delegated|created|visible (default received = assigned to the caller; delegated = created and assigned to someone else; created = every task the caller created; visible = assignee or creator, deduplicated — never every task in the organization), optional q, overdue, page, page_size), interaction_room (rooms|room|messages|attachments|room_links|room_participants|room_impact|resolve_room), diagnostic (get|by_revision).

entity.description: Domain or specialized entity to read (see description for the closed vocabulary).

action.description: Typed entity action — search|get for domain entities; specialized entities declare their own closed action set.

params.description: Action-scoped parameters: id for get; filters/pagination for search; action-specific fields for specialized routes.

tools.description: Versioned knowledge — guidance, never domain truth or AuthZ. source=methodology: TÉO process-methodology playbooks (params: method, task, guide_version v1|v2, intent, context facts). Omit guide_version for the frozen v1 catalog. teo-method-playbooks-v2 adds Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC, Pareto, MSA, FMEA and the other family tools) without replacing SIPOC, Lean, Ishikawa or 5 Whys. Belts are competence references, not certifications. Do not invent statistical results. source=product_guide: Portal/Transformômetro usage guides (params: topic, section).

params.description: Source-scoped parameters (method/task/intent/ context for methodology; topic/section for product_guide).

tools.description: Contexto da VISTA: identidade do assistente, principal, capabilities efetivas do usuário autenticado (derivadas de autorização real — o catálogo informa, nunca concede), modelo de confirmação e catalogVersion. action=context (default) ou action=catalog para o catálogo canônico completo.

Leitura por vocabulário fechado entity+action: playlist.list|get|context, playlist_history.history, data_route.search, data_model.inspect, display_format.list — catálogo autoritativo de formatos de visualização de dados (display modes, tipos de bloco, formatos de valor), slide_preset.list, media_asset.list, slide_template.list|get|export_mdd, product_guide.guide. filters aceita apenas chaves declaradas por ação — chave desconhecida falha tipada (VALIDATION_ERROR). Entidade/ação desconhecida → UNKNOWN_ENTITY/UNKNOWN_ACTION. Capabilities planejadas retornam NOT_IMPLEMENTED honesto.

Análises fechadas do owner: data_block_preview, data_model_preview, intent_materialization (intenção NL → ops tipadas candidatas). Nada persiste; resposta inclui evidenceClass (preview|calculation). Ops candidatas seguem para o envelope governado — nunca persistem por si.

Registro canônico de guias de produto (GUIDANCE_NOT_DOMAIN_TRUTH). action=get: um guia por topic (+section opcional); sem topic = índice. action=search: projeção limitada do índice filtrada por query. Nunca estado de domínio nem autorização.
